reviews.text:
Very pleasant and welcoming. I took my cat Smoky there.

He was hospitalized overnight, and when I picked him up, they called me the next day to check on him. I recommend this clinic.

Hello,
The entire team thanks you for your feedback 😊
Sincerely,
The Veterinary Clinic Team. …

I wanted to thank the clinic for their welcome, and especially Dr. Pierinet for his compassion and kindness towards my rabbit, who frequently makes stopovers and has therefore earned a very nice gold loyalty card at the clinic. Thank you for your kindness; the proof is that Bernie wants to come once or twice a month.

So far, we've been three times for our Swiss White Shepherd. From the receptionist to the two veterinarians we've seen, everything exudes attentiveness, care, gentleness, and a passion for animals. They offer sound advice and rigorous medical expertise. We're thrilled to have such excellent professionals caring for our dog 🤍 …
The team is fantastic, very welcoming, always smiling, and always very kind to animals. I highly recommend this practice.

Hello,
Thank you for your rating and your trust.
Have a lovely day,
The Veterinary Clinic Team.

Always attentive, I would entrust them with my pet without hesitation!

Update 6 years later: Excellent follow-up and a team that's still top-notch, both technically and personally. It's with regret that we're changing clinics due to a move. A huge thank you for everything!

Hello,
Thank you for your rating and your trust.
Have a lovely day,
The Veterinary Clinic Team.

My animals have been cared for by the veterinarians at Le Crayon for years. I appreciate their kindness, welcoming manner, expertise, understanding, and sensitivity, especially when I've been overwhelmed by veterinary emergencies. Their service has remained consistent over the years, even with changes in the team. A heartfelt thank you to everyone for the quality of your work and your care for both us humans and the animals.
Excellent practice, very pleasant people, attentive to animals and their owners.
A caring and attentive team with plenty of good advice for our little ones. I highly recommend this veterinary clinic.
I bought a bag of Royal Canin Cat Neutered Satiety Balance cat food and paid €47.90, but it's advertised on the website at €39.90 and even on sale at €35.90. Is this normal?

How wonderful to know that our Vega will be in good hands at this clinic.
Patience, advice, kindness… they have it all!
Thank you so much.
Excellent care, appropriate treatment, and a cat that's finally healthy. I recommend them 100%.
Thank you Mr. Porte! We are delighted to have you as one of our loyal customers!

The care my dog ​​receives from the team at the Crayon veterinary clinic is impeccable! My dog ​​adores the vets and assistants.
Humans are also very well received: I've always had answers to all my questions.
I also received excellent support during my cat's final days.
We received excellent advice from the on-site veterinarian.

As clients for almost a year, our relationship with the veterinarian started well. However, the service has deteriorated significantly, and our recent visit was a disaster. We had an appointment at 1:20 PM, arrived at the clinic at 1:25 PM, and the appointment didn't begin until 1:26 PM. The receptionist was unpleasant about our lateness, even though we apologized. The appointment was only supposed to last 20 minutes, and we left at 1:39 PM, so our delay didn't disrupt the clinic's operations. It's unnecessary to be so rude, especially when we're such good clients.

Furthermore, we always feel like our care isn't being followed up. They constantly ask about our dog's diet, even though we've already approved it and have it delivered to the clinic. Finally, every little problem leads to recommendations like "hypoallergenic food." In short, we're very disappointed and will probably switch to another vet.
Always the best for my two cats, gentle vets who take the time to relax the animals and give excellent advice, in addition to always being very friendly.
Excellent team – professional, efficient, and friendly. The office is modern, spacious, and bright. I highly recommend this practice.
I have not consulted these veterinarians, but beware they promote homeopathy and naturopathy for animals on their website, so I would be wary of them.

I am shocked by the reception and the veterinarian. It's the first time I've been treated like this. As a new mother, I'm used to seeing doctors, gynecologists, and midwives, and they've always treated me with respect. But in this clinic, the staff are condescending, aggressive, and show no respect whatsoever. I came in to get my dog ​​vaccinated, and they practically threw me out. There were only three people at reception, the clinic was empty, and they spent ten minutes lecturing me instead of doing their jobs. It was a terrible experience, and frankly, I much prefer spending time with kind and pleasant people than with people like them.

A truly unpleasant experience. We were treated terribly by the staff.

We were nine minutes late for our appointment, explained why we were late, and despite this, they were treated condescendingly, refusing to see us even for a shorter consultation. They told us to leave, not to come back, and to "good luck finding another vet," as if they were heart surgeons…
So, we found another, kinder, and more accommodating vet on Place Bellecour who saw us immediately.

And I'm posting a photo in the comments for the receptionist who swore she waited exactly 10 minutes to call us in, even though we were standing right outside the clinic.
Thanks for this awful experience. I understand why people abroad speak ill of the French and their way of treating people. We are your customers, after all. We're the ones paying for your services, and it's thanks to us that your business thrives. The least you can do is understand us, treat us well, and be accommodating when we have a problem, not talk down to us like we're children.

You've lost a customer, and I will do everything I can to let as many people as possible know how you treat your customers. I hope to never see you again.

When I arrive, they always welcome me with professionalism and kindness.
My doctor is young and professional.
The staff are very serious.
But they also provide creams.
Thank you for your professionalism.
Thank you.

First experience with this veterinary clinic. The team is very professional, attentive, caring, and kind to our little friends. I consulted them for my cat, Nala, who had a minor health issue. The team quickly identified the problem and treated the infection. Nala recovered quickly and thanks you immensely for your care. We will definitely return if needed. Thank you ❤️
Excellent veterinary clinic! The vets are very friendly and attentive. They keep track of your pet's vaccinations and ensure they receive timely reminders.
Excellent veterinary practice: available, attentive, and caring! Thank you so much for the care and follow-up for Galathée. Dear pet owners, you can go there with complete confidence.
A very pleasant clinic with a great welcome! I highly recommend it.
When the lure of profit is stronger than ethics... it should be avoided.

This veterinary clinic is very responsive, both by phone and for scheduling an appointment quickly. The staff is extremely attentive, kind, and patient, which makes all the difference for my very timid and fearful dog.

My dog ​​has been a patient there for two years, and I am more than satisfied.

I highly recommend this clinic for their professionalism and kindness.

Excellent clinic. The staff is welcoming, professional, and very kind to animals. They are very responsive, even on the phone. I've been going there for my cat for two and a half years, and I highly recommend this clinic. I will continue to go even though I'm moving soon.
Great experience, very competent and attentive vets ☺️

The vet office was recommended by a friend, and my dog and a cat went there many times already. Small notice: my dog was very traumatised like a pup by another vet. He's super vary of strangers and sensitive to the touch (I saw 3 trainers already and he was even more traumatised by the aversive approach of the second). So, he's always muzzled when he comes to the clinic. But doctors are very compassionate and taking their time, leading me how I can help them and doing their best to make my pup as comfortable as he can be.

Thank you for the rating! We appreciate your feedback!

The Crayon Team
Buying dog food is quite convenient as it's not too far from my work. Pretty handy for emergencies.

If you love your pet... don't take it to this clinic. I'm speaking from experience with my dog ​​who died, and from the analysis and conclusions of other, more qualified veterinarians. Instead of treatment, they'll prescribe thousands of expensive painkillers and narcotics.

I highly recommend this practice. My pets (cat and dog) have been under their care for seven years now, and I am more than satisfied. The veterinarians are excellent and attentive. Furthermore, the reception staff is always available and has consistently responded to my various requests with care and professionalism. You can tell that everyone at the practice is dedicated to their work, which is very pleasant. Thank you!
Available quickly, warm welcome, and they even organize a dog photo contest for Christmas! The vet was very professional and gave me excellent advice on chemical castration. I highly recommend them.

I went to treat Angèle, the tripanée, it was great, the straitjackets were awesome!
Long live pardav!
Dr. Anger is so kind and gentle with his young "patients"! I highly recommend him!

Hello Florian Dupla,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback about our clinic. … More

Dear Logan,

Thank you for your kind review of our practice, Dr. Meunier Anger. We are … More
Highly professional vet with a very friendly welcome; you can go there with complete confidence, your pet will be treated with the utmost care.
Everything is perfect
